name: traces_service_p95_latency_high
title: Service p95 latency above 2 s
description: The p95 duration of a service's server and consumer spans (requests and queue messages it handled) was above 2 seconds in the last 10 minutes, with at least 50 requests. One threshold for every service; raise it for services that are slow by design. Needs OpenTelemetry traces in the traces stream named default.

query_condition.sql: SELECT service_name, COUNT(*) AS requests, approx_percentile_cont(duration, 0.95) / 1000.0 AS p95_ms FROM "default" WHERE span_kind IN ('2', '5') GROUP BY service_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50 AND approx_percentile_cont(duration, 0.95) > 2000000
